# The Drowned Lighthouse

The beam still turns[^turns], and the keeper's log names the year[^year].

A footnote with a longer body, spanning more than one line, because a footnote is
prose and prose runs on[^long].

[^turns]: The mechanism is a clockwork drive, not a flame.

[^year]: 1815, in a hand that is not the keeper's.

[^long]: The log runs to eleven volumes. The last three are water damage, and the
    GM may read whichever of them they like into the story; the point of a
    footnote is that the table can be read without it.
